title: A resolution notifying the President of the United States of the election of a Secretary of the Senate.
latestAction: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S7-8; text: CR S8)
summary: This resolution resolves that the President be notified of the election of Jackie Barber as Secretary of the Senate.
